name: Projected No-Clashing Teaching Dimension / Projected Double Density (affine)
details: For every finite binary class, $\mathrm{NCTD}^{p}(\mathcal H)\geq\mathrm{dens}^{p}(\mathcal H)/2$.
proof: Apply the no-clashing lower bound by one half of the one-inclusion average degree to every coordinate projection, then maximize over the projection.
proof_source: Proposition prop:projected-nctd-low-projected-density in the LaTeX survey.
